notes.title: Symphorix Graduates from Early Access This Month with Full Release 1.0!
notes.content: [p align="start"]Greetings, Cores![/p][p align="start"]It feels like just yesterday that we embarked on this incredible journey with you, launching Symphorix into Early Access. Our story is a unique one: a solo developer from a small village, working alongside passionate students to bring a dream to life.\[[b][url="https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQEaW53Sj5VfOiM3cTHr76tJEqM1j-yGLGjD5UvMSHg3GE3Bjwb9F3iId9Gf-NhNHZ8JzShtr1ah-jYJb5bh9Ug3f1B9HjkNZfWUCVwpq8txr85K6LrOScmdsiV6G6j1fiNugucPB_gDE4mQojO5lIgdHk73JSD15l8kUbU-xCBbzxLiHWkNrd5Vjgz57HgOVEMrg8rjf4SrJwDFimCqA3Kblg%3D%3D"]1[/url][/b]] Your support, feedback, and belief in our music-driven, strategic survivorlike has been the crescendo to our development symphony. Today, we are beyond excited to announce that the next major update will be our full release! Symphorix Version 1.0 will be launching later this month, marking the end of our Early Access chapter and the beginning of a whole new movement.[/p][p align="start"]When we first launched, we promised to remain in Early Access for one to three months to gather your invaluable feedback and polish the experience. We are thrilled to say that, thanks to your input, we are graduating in just two months, having fulfilled the promises we set out to achieve. This is not the end of our journey, but rather, the start of an even more ambitious future for Symphorix. We are committed to at least another year of active development, with tons of exciting content already in the works.[/p][h3]From Early Access to Full Symphony: The 1.0 Overture[/h3][p align="start"]Version 1.0 is a massive leap forward, built on the foundation we laid together during Early Access. We've been hard at work implementing a host of new features, significant improvements, and crucial fixes to make the game a richer, more dynamic, and more rewarding experience.[/p][p align="start"]Here’s a detailed look at what you can expect in the full release:[/p][p][b]New Features: A richer, more dynamic experience[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Bosses by Merit (Per-Note Bosses):[/b] A complete overhaul of progression! You will now earn your way through the orchestral onslaught. Defeat enough enemies of a specific note to summon its boss. Vanquish the boss to unlock the next enemy type and its corresponding musical note. One note at a time, you will conquer the symphony.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Meters on the HUD:[/b] To complement the new boss system, 12 new meters have been added to your display. These trackers show your kill-count for each note, displaying statuses like "Boss Coming," "BOSS ALIVE," and "BOSS KILLED." The meter pulses with each kill and again when you damage the boss, with its intensity growing as you get closer to the showdown. While a boss is active, the meter reflects its real-time health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies Dance on Their Notes:[/b] Prepare for a visual feast! When a song hits the note an enemy represents, they will perform a quick, signature "dance," no matter how far away they are. It's a flashy, fast flourish that adds a new layer of life to the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Epic Death Explosion:[/b] Your demise is no longer a simple fade to black. Now, dying triggers a spectacular cinematic explosion! A massive shockwave, a blinding flash, cascading sparks, and flying energy globes will fill the screen as your core disappears. We've even added a 1.5-second pause before the game over screen so you can fully appreciate the beautiful destruction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Center-Screen Popups:[/b] Important notifications—such as new enemy introductions, level-ups, and upgrade confirmations—are now clearer and more organized. They appear in the center of the screen and stack upwards, ensuring you never miss a critical update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escape Key Shortcut:[/b] A quality-of-life improvement that allows you to press Escape to quickly deselect components and close panels when not in a game session, mirroring the functionality of a right-click.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Improvements: Deeper Strategy, Smoother Flow[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Smarter Orbital Enemies:[/b] Foes that circle you are now far more menacing. They will spiral inward, accelerating when far away and slowing their approach as they get closer, creating dynamic and tense encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Enemies Join the Fight:[/b] A new strategic challenge awaits. Some enemies can now project a healing beam onto a wounded ally, steadily restoring their health. The stronger the healer, the faster the heal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cannibal Enemies Evolve:[/b] A truly terrifying new enemy type can drain the health and power from other enemies, growing larger and more powerful with each "meal." The longer they survive, the greater the threat they become.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Glow-Up:[/b] Bosses are now a single, formidable enemy that arrives at a significantly higher level than the current wave and is scaled up in size for a truly imposing presence.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steady Pressure & Longer Climb:[/b] The enemy count now ramps up smoothly over the first 15 minutes of a run, providing a more consistent challenge. Furthermore, the difficulty for enemies and bosses can now scale up to level 100, ensuring the late-game remains spicy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progression Clarity:[/b] With the new boss system, only the meter for the currently active note will count your kills. Once its boss is defeated, the meter grays out, and the next note's enemies join the fray.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh Song Discovery:[/b] The song list is now randomized every time you start the game, encouraging the discovery of new tracks. Your custom songs will still conveniently appear at the top.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Play Flow:[/b] We've removed the "Accept Costs" button before a run begins. The game now handles this automatically when you hit "Play," getting you into the action faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clearer Announcements & Snappier Animations:[/b] Alerts for new enemy types are now easier to spot in the heat of battle, and a host of animation timings have been polished to ensure they are always snappy and responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Silent Beam Effects:[/b] The new healing and cannibal beams now operate without sound, allowing you to focus on the core combat audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will no longer occasionally get stuck in a deformed state after their note animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Your wallet is now safe! Pasting a node's settings will no longer allow you to go into debt. The action will be blocked if you cannot afford the cost.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Still to Come in Version 1.0[/h3][p align="start"]We're putting the finishing touches on several key features that will also be included in the full release:[/p][list][*][p][b]Achievements:[/b] Test your skills and unlock a full suite of achievements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards:[/b] Compete with players from around the world for the top spot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rating and Ranking Songs:[/b] A system to rate and rank the musical battlegrounds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlocking / Progression System Improvements:[/b] Further refinements to the overall progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Onboarding / Tutorial:[/b] An improved introduction to the game's unique mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy Stealer:[/b] A surprise that we can't wait for you to discover![/p][/*][*][p][b]Different types of Level-up options and a Unique Deterministic Re-Roll Mechanic.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]The Future of Symphorix: Our Post-Launch Roadmap[/h3][p align="start"]As we've said, 1.0 is just the beginning. We have a packed roadmap for the year ahead, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Attack Types:[/b] Prepare to wield the power of Shields and Lightning![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Enemy Variety:[/b] We're designing tons of new enemies to challenge your strategies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Game Modes:[/b] Explore different ways to play with Meditative, Bullet Hell, Strategic, Endless, and a full Campaign mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And much more![/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you once again for being a part of our Early Access journey. Your passion has fine-tuned Symphorix into something we are immensely proud of. We cannot wait for you to experience the full symphony of destruction in Version 1.0 later this month. Stay tuned for the official release date![/p][p align="start"]With heartfelt gratitude,[/p][p align="start"]The OnTriggerJoy Team[/p]

If a player cannot afford multiple Behaviours, Beats, or Notes on a component, selection buttons now act as switches. Previously, new players could not afford a second behaviour but were unable to select a different one. This change allows switching to another option.

notes.title: 0.92 Multi Select songs / Playlist Mode
notes.content:
[h3]#New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Your Personal DJ Set![/b]: Create custom song playlists and let your game DJ through them automatically![/p][list][*][p]Hold Ctrl and click songs in the song list to build your perfect playlist - no more same song during long survival sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]During game sessions, your playlist automatically advances when each song finishes[/p][/*][*][p]Watch your selected songs light up in the list to see which ones are in your playlist[/p][/*][*][p]Your first-selected song stays the "main" one for all bonuses and synergies [/p][/*][*][p]Outside game sessions, single songs loop normally so you can configure your core without interruption[/p][/*][*][p]The HUD can show you "Currently Playing (2/5): Song Name" so you always know which track is pumping[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Perfect for building the ultimate gaming soundtrack that keeps you motivated through long sessions!

#Fixed Issues[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Secondary Thruster Behavior Fixed[/b]: Your secondary thruster particle system now properly syncs with your main thruster! It automatically stops emitting when you stop moving, just like the main thruster. This prevents lingering particle effects when pausing the game, returning to main menu after death, or exiting via the pause menu. Plus, any existing world-space particles gracefully fade out naturally instead of being abruptly cut off. Your thruster effects are now perfectly synchronized and won't haunt your main menu with unwanted visual noise![/p][/*][/list]

Existing coin multipliers remain effective.[/p][/*][/list]

Expanded enemy variety.
Boss improvements and balancing.
Chain Attack system enhancements.

notes.title: V 0.26 Biggest update yet, DEMO also updated
notes.content:
[h1]🎮 [0.26.0] - 2024-06-25 Musical Mayhem Update[/h1]

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]

[h3]🎼 Musical Enemies Crescendo[/h3]
We've revamped how enemies appear throughout your battle!

Now enemies make a proper entrance - each musical note's enemies will be introduced with a stylish announcement when they join the battle

Start with just one enemy type and gradually meet the whole orchestra as difficulty increases

No more facing the entire enemy band from the get-go - you'll have time to learn each enemy's style before meeting the next one

The progression is tied to each song, so you'll always get the same enemy sequence for your favorite tracks

Consider it enemy matchmaking based on your musical taste!

[h3]🎯 Precision Kinetic System[/h3]
Master your energy with surgical precision!

Bursts now ONLY fire when YOU choose - either by manual click or smart auto-fire

Auto-bursts trigger automatically when your energy battery fills during sustained fire

All bursts now laser-target your mouse cursor for pixel-perfect aiming

Continuous fire maintains pressure while building up to devastating full-battery bursts

No more surprise discharges - complete control over your firepower

[h2]🌈 Improvements[/h2]

[h3]🎨 Song Color Makeover[/h3]
We've completely revamped how colors are generated from your music!

Colors are now much more varied and unique for each song

No more getting similar colors for different songs

Smarter color selection ensures UI elements stay clear and readable

Even if a song can't be loaded properly, you'll still get consistent colors based on the filename

Say goodbye to those confusing moments when song colors looked too similar to red/green UI indicators

Your game's color palette will now perfectly complement your musical selections without interfering with gameplay clarity

[h3]🌈 Technicolor Projectiles[/h3]
Enemy projectiles just got a fabulous makeover!

Projectiles now match the color of the enemy that fired them

No more boring white projectiles - now they're as colorful as the enemies themselves

This makes it easier to tell who's shooting at you in the heat of battle

Plus, enemy colors are now more vibrant and eye-catching with maximum saturation

It's like your enemies went shopping for neon paint - and they're not afraid to use it!

[h3]🎲 Shapeshifting Hitboxes[/h3]
Enemies now feel more "real" than ever before!

Enemy hitboxes now perfectly match their visual appearance

Those spiky protrusions? Yep, they'll actually hit you now

No more frustrating moments where you thought you dodged but got hit anyway

Ultra-smooth organic contours instead of blocky angular shapes

The collision feels much more natural and precise

It's like the enemies just got an upgrade to their physical presence in the game world!

[h3]🔄 Complete Enemy Spawning Overhaul[/h3]
We're rebuilding our enemy spawning system from the ground up!

The old music-based enemy spawning system is being replaced with something more exciting

This will give us greater control over enemy progression and difficulty scaling

Expect more interesting enemy patterns and choreographed encounters in future updates

The new system will tie more deeply into game progression and difficulty curves

Stay tuned for more details as we complete this major upgrade!

[h3]🖥️ Cleaned Up Game HUD[/h3]
We've streamlined your in-game display to focus only on what you need most!

Removed all the enemy spawner clutter and boss-related UI elements

Simplified the screen to show just your kinetic energy, time dilation info, level, and heart crystals

No more distracting health and energy sliders taking up your precious screen space

Enjoy a cleaner, more focused view that lets you concentrate on the action

Your game performance might even be a tiny bit better with less UI to render

[h3]👾 Enemy Visual System Rework[/h3]
Behind the scenes, we've completely overhauled how enemies look and animate!

Removed the old sphere-based visual system for something much more exciting (stay tuned!)

Simplified enemy effects for better performance and clearer visual feedback

Paved the way for more dynamic and expressive enemy designs

Don't worry - your enemies will still explode in satisfying ways when defeated!

[h3]🌟 Visual Makeover for Your Core[/h3]
We've given your Core's visual system a serious upgrade!

Each Core component now gets its own unique copy of materials - no more identity crises where one component's color changes affect others!

Added fancy new color controls so your Core components can express themselves with Primary and Secondary colors

Introduced a slick new Pulse effect that makes your Core briefly "flex" before returning to normal - perfect for those "did you see that?!" moments

Added Health visualization directly on your Core - now you can literally see how your Core is feeling!

All these visual bells and whistles work behind the scenes with no performance hit - your Core is now both prettier AND more efficient!

[h3]🧠 Smart Shapes System[/h3]
Your Core components just got a memory upgrade!

Components now store their unique shape identity in memory without actually using it

This "shape memory" is saved for future use by enemy systems - your Core keeps its classic look for now

Each exhaust node still maintains its own consistent, direction-specific seed

This prepares for a future update where enemies will use your shape patterns

Behind the scenes, this makes your Core much smarter about how it manages appearance data

Core components and enemies can now decide independently whether to use stored shape patterns

[h3]🌊 Reduced Visual Effects[/h3]
We've removed the rhythmic pulsing effects from the ground to make the game more accessible and comfortable for all players!

The ground no longer pulses in response to music beats

This change helps reduce potential motion sensitivity issues

Makes the gameplay experience more comfortable for everyone

[h3]⚡ Smart Kinetic Discharge[/h3]
Your kinetic energy system just got smarter!

Automatic bursts now fire when your energy battery fills up during continuous attacks

Bursts now always fire toward your mouse cursor for precise aiming

Continuous fire and automatic bursts work together seamlessly - lay down suppressive fire while building up to big bursts!

[h3]🔋 Streamlined Energy Management[/h3]
Removed automatic emergency braking discharges

Energy system now focuses purely on offensive capabilities

Visual clutter from old direction indicators removed

[h3]🏃 Enemy Visual Feedback[/h3]
Enemies now properly face their movement direction, making their behavior more readable

[h3]🌀 Teleportation Effects[/h3]
Teleporting enemies now show distinct particle effects at both departure and arrival locations

[h2]🐛 Fixed Issues[/h2]

[h3]🚫 No More Double Notifications[/h3]
Fixed an annoying bug where cutting component settings would show you two popup messages - one for cutting and another for copying. Now we'll only bother you once when you cut, just as nature intended!

[h3]🕵️ Preset Detective[/h3]
Your presets "heavy missile", "heavy sniper", "broodmother", and "my child" had gone into hiding, but we've tracked them down! They will now load properly when selected, no more "failed to load" messages getting in the way of your musical mayhem.

[h3]⏰ Time-Traveling Presets[/h3]
Found some of your old presets containing stats from previous versions causing errors? We've taught the preset system to be more adaptable! It will now safely ignore any outdated stats while still applying everything else, ensuring your favorite configurations can stand the test of time.

[h3]🔤 Case-Insensitive Genius[/h3]
Our preset system has become more forgiving about capitalization in stat names. It no longer cares if you wrote "FreeFlightPower" or "freeflightpower" - it'll figure it out! Your presets will load much more reliably no matter how they were saved.

[h3]🎬 Start Session Fix[/h3]
Fixed a bug where the "Start Session" button would stay stubbornly off after you reset everything, even if the session was free. Now it correctly realizes when you can start playing!

[h3]🎯 Directional Hint TLC[/h3]
Removed the confusing kinetic discharge direction indicator since bursts now always follow your mouse cursor. No more mixed signals about where your firepower is headed!

[h3]🌈 Teleportation Effect Cleanup[/h3]
Fixed teleportation effects appearing three times instead of two (departure/arrival)

notes.title: V 22.1 Demo Updated
notes.content:
🚀 Infinite Exploration (v0.22.0)
The universe is now truly yours to explore! We've removed all map boundaries so you can roam freely without ever hitting an invisible wall. Your ship is now the center of its own universe - literally!

🎮 Improved Ship Controls (v0.21.0)
Smoother Direction Changes: Change directions without triggering emergency brakes thanks to a new grace period that makes quick maneuvers more responsive.
Better Braking Control: Emergency brakes only trigger when you fully release all movement controls, giving you complete control over your ship.
Enhanced Visual Feedback: Brake particles now shoot in the direction you were moving, making the braking system more intuitive.

⚡ Kinetic Energy System Overhaul (v0.22.1)
Accurate Targeting: Your continuous kinetic attacks now fire correctly toward your mouse cursor instead of in the wrong direction.
Balanced Energy System: We've fixed issues with the continuous kinetic discharge system to ensure your attacks fire consistently when left-clicking.
Improved Energy Meter: The energy meter now accurately shows your generation and usage rates, helping you better manage your kinetic energy during intense battles.
Accurate Stats Display: The HUD now correctly displays your actual fire rate stat value.

🛠️ Other Improvements
Smooth Thruster Rotation: Thrusters now gradually rotate to new directions instead of instantly snapping, creating more natural-looking movement.
No More Surprise Bursts: Removed automatic bursts that would trigger when hitting walls or objects - you're now fully in control of when your ship fires kinetic bursts.
Better Energy Feedback: The directional hint clearly shows how much kinetic energy you have stored.
Fixed Weapon Firing: You can now fire kinetic attacks while using time dilation (right-click).

🐛 Important Bug Fixes
Fixed stat modifications disappearing after returning from a game session
Fixed an issue where modifying Core component stats wasn't showing up in the session cost display
Fixed thruster particles pointing in the wrong direction during kinetic bursts
Fixed continuous aimed firing to accurately track your mouse position
We're constantly working to improve symphorix based on your feedback. Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy these new updates!

[h1]Version 0.18.0: Leveling, Projectiles, and Streamlined Systems[/h1]

This update focuses on adding a leveling system, improving projectiles, streamlining gameplay systems, and fixing various bugs.

[h2]Key Changes[/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Automatic Leveling System Added:[/b]
    [list]
        [*]Your stats now increase automatically as you level up.
        [*]Level progression is integrated into the core gameplay.
        [*]The UI shows your current level and changes.
        [*]Stats are recalculated when you level up.
    [/list]
    [*][b]Gameplay System Improvements:[/b]
    [list]
        [*]The camera has been improved.
        [*]The sound system has been updated for better performance.
        [*]The event system (which handles in-game events) has been enhanced.
        [*]Gameplay components have been optimized.
        [*]The user interface has been updated.
    [/list]
    [*][b]Projectile System Overhaul:[/b]
    [list]
        [*]Projectiles now use physics-based movement for more realistic interactions.
        [*]Collisions between projectiles and other objects are now more accurate, including trigger-based detection.
        [*]Projectiles can now damage each other.
        [*]Projectiles may deflect based on damage.
        [*]Projectile size can change based on its remaining energy.
        [*]Projectiles now automatically interact with the environment in a more logical way.
        [*]Collision responses, including push forces, have been improved.
        [*]Explosion damage and push forces are calculated more accurately.
    [/list]
    [*][b]Stat System Changes:[/b]
    [list]
        [*]Stats now scale automatically based on your level.
        [*]Stat calculations have been improved to include level-based increases.
    [/list]
    [*][b]Streamlined Cost System:[/b]
       [list]
        [*] Some features will have a free usage, now.
        [*]The first time you use specific assignable abilities, they will be free.
        [*]The cost display now shows which features have free uses.
        [*]Redundant cost displays have been removed.
    [/list]
    [*][b]Note Activation Changes:[/b]
    [list]
        [*]Notes now activate instantly without any delay.
    [/list]
     [*][b]Stat Adjustments:[/b]
     [list]
        [*]Irrelevant stat modifications are now cleared when abilities are disabled.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed issues with how stat attributes were displayed.
    [*]Improved the responsiveness of the controls.
    [*]Fixed various audio-related bugs.
    [*]Fixed the display of font sizes and text in the UI.
    [*]Fixed an issue where the cost of certain features was calculated incorrectly (showing as 0 when it shouldn't).
    [*]Fixed a bug where the first free use of certain abilities was not being handled correctly.
[/list]
